title: The Web at the Hut
lines: Deb, Ned and Wag run to the hut.
It is wet in the fog.
A big web is up at the top.
"Do not! A bug is in it," said Deb.
Deb gets a peg and pins the web up.
"We can get in," said Ned. Wag wags.
Deb, Ned and Wag nap in the hut.

questions.ask: What was up at the top of the hut?
questions.listenFor: A big web. Line three says it. If your child is stuck, put a finger on that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: Why did Deb tell Ned not to bat the web?
questions.listenFor: Because a bug was living in it. Line five says it. This is the turn of the story, so it is worth a little talk.

questions.ask: What would you have done about the web? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for the reason, not the choice.
